mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM turns WHERE state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') ORDER BY thread_id

SELECT x.turn_id AS turnId,x.thread_id AS threadId,x.state,x.mutation_version AS mutationVersion, x.cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt,e.schema_version AS schemaVersion,e.state_json AS stateJson FROM turns x LEFT JOIN turn_execution e ON e.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') ORDER BY x.turn_sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE turns SET state='CANCELLED',mutation_version=mutation_version+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt},completed_at=#{occurredAt}, accepting_inputs=0,input_queue_revision=input_queue_revision+1, terminal_summary='Cancelled before sidecar restart',error_code='CANCELLED', error_message='The Turn cancellation request was committed before the sidecar stopped.' WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND mutation_version=#{expectedTurnMutationVersion} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL

UPDATE turns SET state='FAILED',mutation_version=mutation_version+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt},completed_at=#{occurredAt}, accepting_inputs=0,input_queue_revision=input_queue_revision+1, terminal_summary='Execution recovery failed',error_code='TURN_EXECUTION_STATE_CORRUPT', error_message='The persisted Turn execution state is missing or invalid.' WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND mutation_version=#{expectedTurnMutationVersion} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT call_id,state,revision,ordinal,tool_name,side_effect FROM tools WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND ordinal=#{ordinal}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM interaction_requests WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND tool_call_id=#{callId} AND status='PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE tools SET state='FAILED', presentation_json=json_set(presentation_json,'$.status','error','$.outputPreview', 'Tool binding is unavailable.'), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages(message_id,thread_id,turn_id,ordinal,role,blocks_json,created_at) VALUES(#{messageId},#{threadId},#{turnId}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal)+1,1) FROM messages WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}),'TOOL', json_array(json_object('kind','tool_result','callId',#{callId},'content',#{content},'error',json('true'))), #{occurredAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE approvals SET decision='DENY',resolved_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND decision IS NULL AND expires_at<#{occurredAt}
UPDATE approvals SET decision='DENY',resolved_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND decision IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO turn_change_sets(thread_id,turn_id,workspace_id,change_set_json,artifact_id,committed_at) SELECT x.thread_id,x.turn_id,t.workspace_id, json_object('state','partial','incompleteReasons',json_array('recovery_boundary'),'files',json_array(), 'stats',json_object('files',0,'additions',0,'deletions',0,'binaryFiles',0,'truncated',json('false'))), NULL,#{occurredAt} FROM turns x JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=x.thread_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.completed_at=#{occurredAt} AND x.state IN ('CANCELLED','FAILED') AND x.error_code IN ('CANCELLED','TURN_EXECUTION_STATE_CORRUPT') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_change_sets c WHERE c.turn_id=x.turn_id)
